title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction: Setting: this page continues the 'suite' to La Longue Marche, section 120, 'Scindages de l'extension G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G'. Grothendieck has an extension (241/243) of the relative symmetric group (S_3)_{S_0} by a rank-2 lattice-type group scheme M (with sections λ0, λ1). He wants to decide whether it splits, because he hopes (previous page) to identify the map M_{0,3} → Aff with M_{0,3} → G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G. Such an identification would force the extension to split, and isomorphisms with Aff correspond to splittings. He fixes lifts ρ, σ of the generators of S_3. These satisfy ρ^3 = 1 and σ^2 = 1, but only σρσ^{-1} = ρ^{-1}λ1, so the dihedral relation fails by λ1. Any splitting is then given by ρ' = ξρ and σ' = ησ with ξ, η ∈ ΓM (244). Modern language: one computes the set of 1-cocycle corrections that turn a set-theoretic section into a homomorphism. The page treats each relation in turn. (1) ρ'^3 = 1 becomes (1+ρ+ρ^2)ξ = 0 (245). This holds automatically because 1+ρ_M+ρ_M^2 = 0 on M (246): M is the 2-dimensional 'reduced' representation with no Z/3-invariants. (2) σ'^2 = 1 becomes (1+σ_M)η = 0. So η is anti-invariant, η = bδ with δ = λ1 − λ0 and b ∈ ΓG_0, i.e. a locally constant Z-valued function (247). (3) He writes ξ = a0λ0 + a1λ1 (248). He then expands σ'(ρ') := σ'ρ'σ'^{-1} = int(η)[σ(ξ)·ρ^{-1}λ1] and sets it equal to ρ'^{-1} = ρ^{-1}ξ^{-1}. Conjugating by ρ gives ρσ(ξ)·λ1 = ρ(η)^{-1}ξ^{-1}η. On the next page this becomes, additively, (1+ε1)(ξ) + λ1 = (1−ρ)(η) with ε1 = ρσ, and finally 2a1 − a0 + 1 = 3b. Hence splittings exist iff 2a1 − a0 + 1 ≡ 0 mod 3, for example a0 = 1, a1 = b = 0. When 3 is regular on the base (e.g. S = Spec Ẑ), η is determined by ξ. The splitting scheme Sc is the affine sublattice {(a0,a1,b) : 2a1 − a0 − 3b = −1}. This is a torsor under the corresponding rank-2 linear lattice, on which M acts by conjugation. Modulo M-conjugacy one recovers H^1(S_3, M), a small finite group (Z/3-type for this hexagonal lattice). Conceptually this is the classical computation of splittings of crystallographic groups Z^2 ⋊ S_3, the hexagonal wallpaper groups and affine Weyl type, done here over a base.
errors: In (244) the image appears to read (ρ',σ') = (ξρ, ηρ); this should be (ξρ, ησ), as the subsequent computation and the next page (σ' = ησ) make clear.
Equation number (246) is used twice: once for 1+ρ_M+ρ_M^2 = 0 and once for ησ(η) = 1.

On the next page the additive form is written ρ_M(η) − ξ + η, but from ρ(η)^{-1}ξ^{-1}η it should be −ρ_M(η) − ξ + η. The following line, (1−ρ_M)(η), is nevertheless correct, so this is only a transcription-level slip.
Minor: the statement (247), η = bδ, presupposes that the anti-invariants of σ on M are exactly Zδ. This is true for the A2-type lattice used, but it is stated without justification.

ideas.what: Parametrising splittings of an extension of S_3 by a rank-2 S_3-lattice via lifts ρ' = ξρ, σ' = ησ and translating the Coxeter/dihedral relations into linear equations on ξ, η
ideas.modern_name: Non-abelian / group-cohomology computation of the splittings of 1 → M → E → S_3 → 1 (torsor under Z^1(S_3, M); conjugacy classes = H^1(S_3, M))
ideas.where_published: Not in published texts; part of the unpublished continuation of La Longue Marche (cote 140-4)

ideas.what: Using 1+ρ+ρ^2 = 0 on the A2-type lattice to make the order-3 relation automatic, and the anti-invariant line Zδ to solve σ'^2 = 1
ideas.modern_name: Norm element vanishing on the reduced regular representation; H^2(Z/3, M) = 0

ideas.what: Doing this relative over a base S_0 (e.g. Spec Ẑ), with the scheme of splittings as a torsor, motivated by identifying M_{0,3} → Aff with M_{0,3} → G_{ρ,σ}/μ_G
ideas.modern_name: Scheme of sections/splittings of an extension of finite étale group schemes; Teichmüller-tower / Galois–Teichmüller context
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Esquisse / Longue Marche program) for the context
ideas.where_published: Context related to La Longue Marche (1981) and Esquisse d'un programme; this specific computation unpublished

deep.surprise_reason: A careful but routine computation of splittings of an S_3-extension by a rank-2 lattice (the hexagonal crystallographic situation) over a base. It is technically interesting as a working step of the unpublished Longue Marche continuation, but contains nothing a specialist would find new.
transcription_corrections: (244): the image reads '(ξρ, ηρ)', a Grothendieck slip for (ξρ, ησ); the machine transcription reproduces it.
'comme ρ^3=1 dans (S_3)_{S_0}' — the subscript is s_0 / S_0 as in the previous page; the reading is fine.
Under the brace: σ(ρ) = ρ^{-1}λ1 is correctly read; ρ'^{-1} = ρ^{-1}ξ^{-1} is correctly read.
'soit, en multipliant à gauche par ρ [?]' — more precisely 'en conjuguant par ρ'; the operation performed is conjugation by ρ.
